CRM.rationale: CRM presents a genuinely strong earnings inflection — revenue +13.3% YoY, diluted EPS +52.2% YoY, net margin expanding from ~12.7% to ~18.7%, and operating cash flow of $6.70B in Q1 FY2027. The franchise remains dominant (20% global CRM share, #1 for 13 consecutive years, 90%+ Fortune 500 penetration). Valuation has compressed dramatically to 17.6x PE (from 55x a year ago), placing the stock at the floor of its 365-day range with a 5.7% earnings yield that now exceeds the 10-year Treasury at 4.54%. The price is ~41% below its 52-week high despite materially improved fundamentals, creating favorable risk/reward asymmetry. However, the balance sheet has been severely impaired — debt surged from $8.44B to $39.28B (likely acquisition-funded), debt-to-equity moved to 1.15x, and equity shrank 44%. This introduces meaningful integration and leverage risk that caps the score. The AI transition (Agentforce ARR $1.2B, +205%) is a credible growth vector but remains early and unproven at scale. The September 2, 2026 earnings report is a near-term catalyst that could re-rate the stock if the earnings trajectory and Agentforce adoption continue. Score reflects strong Pillar 1 (earnings trajectory + franchise quality), attractive Pillar 2 (historically cheap valuation), tempered by balance-sheet risk and a modest Pillar 3 bump for the upcoming earnings catalyst.
